name: Romeo Montague
atk_text: He never counts the cost. Costs 20 of your own HP.
blk_text: Exiled from the only wall he had. Negate the attack entirely. Loses 10 HP each time it does.

name: Juliet Capulet
atk_text: I am lost without thy love.  +10 each turn it stays in play.
blk_text: Forty-two hours of nothing reaching her. Prevent the next 🔥 Burn.

name: Tybalt
atk_text: Silver tongue, silver blade. Gains 🗡️ Pierce.
blk_text: Inflict 🪢 Tear on the attacker.

name: Mercutio
atk_name: A Plague on Both Your Houses
atk_text: The curse costs him everything, and lands on everyone. Costs 20 of your own HP.
blk_text: Discard a random card from hand to resolve.

name: Friar Laurence
atk_text: I have something for that ailment. Grant an ally ✨ Highlight.
blk_text: All allies reduce incoming damage by 10 until your next turn.

name: The Nurse
atk_text: Peace, child. Heal 20 HP.
blk_text: Clear 🫆 Smudge and 🩹 Glue.

name: Count Paris
atk_text: Come at thee, if you dare.
blk_text: Every door is already open to him. Caps incoming damage at 10.

name: Lord and Lady Capulet
atk_text: Thine own can stand not to this house. Inflict 🩹 Glue and 🫆 Smudge.
blk_text: 🪃 Riposte — while charged, attackers take 20.

name: Lord and Lady Montague
atk_text: Blood for blood.
blk_name: A Wife Who Did Not Survive It
blk_text: Clear 🔥 Burn from an ally.

name: Rosaline
atk_text: Innocence is a burden of a chosen few. Remove the target's ✨ Highlight.
blk_text: The one refusal nobody argues with. Blocks 60 instead against attacks costing 3 or more.

name: The Apothecary
atk_text: His poverty consents, not his will. Inflict 🔥 Burn.
blk_text: Come, come, there's more here.

name: Benvolio
atk_text: Make way, make way! Grant ✨ Highlight.
blk_name: I Do But Keep the Peace
blk_text: Negate one incoming status effect.

name: Odysseus
atk_name: The Man of Twists and Turns
atk_text: Nothing will stop me from getting home. Grant ✨ Highlight.
blk_text: No name to aim at. Negate one incoming status effect.

name: Telemachus
atk_text: +10 each turn it stays in play.
blk_text: Clear 🫆 Smudge.

name: Penelope
atk_text: Never underestimate a womans patience or might. The target’s next attack deals 20 less.
blk_text: Undone each night, begun again each morning. Negate the attack entirely, but every use costs 1 more ABC than the last, up to 4.

name: Antinous
atk_text: I take and then I take again. Inflict 🩸 Siphon — 10 HP a turn for 2 turns, half returned.
blk_text: Here me now, all yee who stand before me!

name: Helen of Troy
atk_text: Show me a beautiful woman and i'll show you a man ready to go to war for her. +10 each turn it stays in play.
blk_text: Clear 🔥 Burn and 🫟 Spill.

name: Clytemnestra
atk_text: No armour, no warning, no escape. Gains 🗡️ Pierce.
blk_text: She has had a decade to prepare it. 🪃 Riposte — while charged, attackers take 20.

name: Circe
atk_text: Filthy beings. Inflict 🩹 Glue.
blk_text: Heal 20 HP.

name: Eumaeus
atk_text: Trust is short supply these days. Grant your next Backstage character ✨ Highlight.
blk_text: Clear one negative status from every ally.

name: Athena
atk_text: Guidance is just that, what you do with it is your own choice. Grant an ally 📝 Margin Notes.
blk_text: Grant your next Backstage character 🛡️ Laminate.

name: Calypso
atk_text: What is time to an immortal? Inflict 🩹 Glue.
blk_name: The Island That Does Not Let Go
blk_text: Blocks 60 instead while Odysseus waits Backstage.

name: Menelaus
atk_text: Listen, you might learn something. Grant your next Backstage character 📕 Hardcover.
blk_text: Clear 🪢 Tear from an ally.

name: Eurylochus
atk_text: He talks the crew into it, and the crew does not come back. Costs 20 of your own HP.
blk_text: Discard a charged Block ABC to resolve.

name: Polyphemus
atk_text: One eye, tenfold might. Inflict ✂️ Rip.
blk_text: Caps incoming damage at 10.

name: Sinon
atk_text: He lets them torture him to sell it. Inflict 🫆 Smudge.
blk_text: Inflict 🩹 Glue on the attacker.

name: Agamemnon
atk_text: Trust no woman, he says, and is wrong. Inflict 🫆 Smudge.
blk_text: Inflict 🪢 Tear on the attacker.

name: Charybdis and Scylla
atk_name: Six Men or All of Them
atk_text: There is no course between them that costs nothing. Inflict 🪢 Tear and 🫟 Spill.
blk_text: 🪃 Riposte — while charged, attackers lose a charged ABC.

name: Phemius the Bard
atk_text: Let me tell you a tale...Draw 1.
blk_text: Mercy is but a blessing
